title: Law to require a city AI emergency response plan
summary: This bill would require the Office of Technology and Innovation's Cyber Command, with NYC Emergency Management, to create or update an emergency response plan for threats posed by artificial intelligence models to city infrastructure, operations and public health within 120 days of enactment. The plan must be submitted to the Mayor and Council Speaker, reviewed and updated annually, and accompanied by yearly progress reports on AI-related emergencies from the prior 12 months.
